ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Three congruent isosceles trapeziums are assembled to form an equilateral triangle with a hole in the middle, as shown in the diagram. What is the perimeter of the hole?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left, three congruent isosceles trapezoids are drawn, among which the top trapezoid marks the shorter upper base as a and the longer lower base as b. The figure on the right shows these three trapezoids rotated to form an equilateral triangular outer frame, leaving a gray triangular hole in the middle. Reasoning: Look at the bottom trapezoid in the assembled figure. Its parallel side facing the inside corresponds to length a, but the two adjacent trapezoids on the left and right will each occupy a segment at the two ends of this side. Since the original trapezoid is an isosceles trapezoid, the extra length b-a by which the long base b exceeds the short base a is evenly distributed at the two ends, so the length cut off at each end is (b-a)/2. Therefore one side length of the gray hole is a - 2·((b-a)/2) = a - (b-a) = 2a-b. The whole tiling has threefold rotational symmetry, so the middle gray hole is an equilateral triangle, with perimeter 3(2a-b)=6a-3b.

raw_record.question_text: Three congruent isosceles trapeziums are assembled to form an equilateral triangle with a hole in the middle, as shown in the diagram. What is the perimeter of the hole?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the left shows one isosceles trapezium with shorter parallel side labeled a and longer parallel side labeled b; the right shows three congruent copies rotated to make an equilateral triangular frame, with the gray central hole also triangular. Focus on the bottom trapezium in the assembled figure. Its inner-facing parallel side has total length a, but the left and right neighboring trapezia cut off equal end pieces from that side. Since the trapezium is isosceles, the excess length b-a of the longer base is split equally between the two ends, so each cut-off piece has length (b-a)/2. Therefore one side of the central hole is a - 2((b-a)/2) = 2a-b. By the 3-fold symmetry of the assembly, the hole is an equilateral triangle, so its perimeter is 3(2a-b)=6a-3b.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：左侧画出三个全等的等腰梯形，其中最上面的梯形标出较短的上底为 a、较长的下底为 b。右侧图形显示这三个梯形经过旋转拼成一个等边三角形外框，中间留下一个灰色的三角形孔。推理：看拼成图形中底部的那个梯形。它朝向内部的平行边对应长度 a，但左右两个相邻梯形会在这条边的两端各占去一段。由于原梯形是等腰梯形，长底 b 比短底 a 多出的长度 b-a 平均分布在两端，所以每端被截去的长度为 (b-a)/2。因此灰色孔的一条边长为 a - 2·((b-a)/2) = a - (b-a) = 2a-b。整个拼法具有三重旋转对称性，所以中间灰色孔是等边三角形，周长为 3(2a-b)=6a-3b。

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: three congruent isosceles trapeziums form a triangular frame, and the gray triangular hole is bounded by parts of the three inner-facing short bases. Instead of finding one side first, count the whole boundary contribution. The three inner-facing short bases have total length 3a. At each end of each such base, a small segment is not part of the gray hole because it is occupied by the neighboring trapezium; there are six such end segments around the hole. For one isosceles trapezium, the longer base exceeds the shorter base by b-a, split into two equal end offsets, so each excluded segment is (b-a)/2. Thus the hole perimeter equals total inner-facing base length minus the six excluded pieces: 3a - 6((b-a)/2) = 3a - 3(b-a) = 6a-3b.
